title: From Horizon Scanning to Horizon Walking

limits.retry_policy: retain initial failure; at most one bounded technical retry per shot

shots.title: The source a beginner must read
steps: Resolve paragraph 60025 to its retained original Chapter 60 PDF and exact page through the manifest/source link.
Open that page in a real PDF viewer; frame the paragraph, abbreviations and footnote context together.
shots.permitted_claim: This is the source material to be understood, before adding reading assistance.
shots.does_not_establish: Not an example of AI failure, nor evidence that every reader finds the material difficult.
shots.fallback: Use the exact retained PDF in a local viewer, clearly labelled frozen source; never recreate the source as invented HTML.

shots.title: Reading help alongside the unchanged passage
steps: Select one actual highlighted abbreviation in paragraph 60025.
Keep the extracted passage and the separate expansion/proposal card visible.
Record the exact occurrence and source-span identity.
shots.permitted_claim: A reader can inspect just-in-time help and trace it back to a specific occurrence.
shots.does_not_establish: No guarantee that every proposed expansion or legal interpretation is correct.
shots.fallback: Use the preserved Chapter 60 v1 route and identify it as the fallback, not the corpus release.

shots.title: Follow this reference, not just this number
steps: Select a raised body reference marker and follow its paired footer occurrence.
Where available, open its dated statutory-link card without claiming the linked legal body is in the package.
Retain unresolved/territorial/date qualifications.
shots.permitted_claim: Citation navigation is bound to an occurrence, with its uncertainty exposed.
shots.does_not_establish: A navigation link is not retained legal evidence or a finding of legal applicability.
shots.fallback: Capture the real unresolved reference state; do not repair or invent a target for the picture.

shots.title: Processing coverage includes extraction gaps
steps: Use the catalogue/document controls to show a genuine extraction-blocked page or recorded gap.
Use a separate original release-report view for aggregate counts if the UI does not expose them.
shots.permitted_claim: The processing ledger records missing extraction rather than pretending every page is readable.
shots.does_not_establish: 893 extraction gaps do not mean 893 blank PDF pages; coverage is not answer accuracy.
shots.fallback: Screenshot the original pinned release record, labelled a repository report rather than an application screen.

shots.title: The UC effective-date question: a retained retrieval miss
steps: Read the out-of-sample JSON and the complete follow-up note.
Capture the original rendered repository note containing the question, the observation and limitations; use two readable frames if needed.
Only use a product view for this case if a real supported view exists. Do not add the case to the frozen forty-question register.
shots.permitted_claim: The retained test exposes an evidence-selection and routing failure that can be investigated.
shots.does_not_establish: Not a fresh current-service result, an LRM reasoning result, a validated answer, or one of the frozen 40 cases.
shots.fallback: Capture the real pinned Markdown/JSON in a readable browser view, explicitly labelled diagnostic record.

shots.title: Inspect the effective-date branch in its source
steps: Use the exact retained ADM A4 PDF and inspect page 36, A4361, including heading and qualifications.
Capture companion page 34, A4352, if necessary to show the exception pointer.
Compare any live PDF with the frozen version before identifying the two as the same source.
shots.permitted_claim: A reviewer can inspect the branch that was missing from the retained retrieval.
shots.does_not_establish: This is not proof that the system selected it; assessment-period boundaries and full legal/factual applicability remain unverified.
shots.fallback: Render the exact local retained PDF without OCR or recreated text; keep page 34 as a companion, not a spliced synthetic page.

shots.title: Ask a fresh question against pinned evidence
steps: Open Ask OKF and enter the exact capital question specified in the instructions.
Use 64 records, 128 relationships, depth 6 and 524288 bytes.
Capture the completed result and save its actual receipt; do not call an answer model.
shots.permitted_claim: This is a new evidence assembly, with explicit selection and budget limits.
shots.does_not_establish: A retrieval improvement does not establish an accurate AI answer or legal completeness.
shots.fallback: Use the original retained observation, labelled historical; do not report a failed or unavailable fresh run as successful.

shots.title: Inspect a selected passage and its provenance
steps: Resolve the capital-related retained case from the actual manifest; do not guess its staff ID.
Choose the appropriate actual selected capital passage, preferably the documented U07/DMG 84861 path when present.
Show exact passage text, original source link/page and transformation/provenance information.
shots.permitted_claim: A retained package can be inspected back to its recorded source and extraction.
shots.does_not_establish: This saved package is not automatically the fresh result captured in S07; hashes do not establish meaning.
shots.fallback: Use another documented selected passage in the same retained case and report the substitution, without changing the evidence.

shots.title: A dependency and a missing requirement
steps: In the same retained case as S08, inspect one directed relationship and its evidence references.
Capture the associated missing requirement or omission in a companion frame or readable native layout.
Do not assume a generic graph edge is a legal or calculation dependency.
shots.permitted_claim: The interface exposes both why passages are connected and what is still missing.
shots.does_not_establish: Relationships alone do not establish a complete rule or an approved legal interpretation.
shots.fallback: Capture the native relationship table and requirements separately; do not draw invented graph edges.

shots.title: A calculation model that deliberately cannot calculate
shots.presentation_act: C — Inspecting and challenging the system
steps: Open staff-016 and Calculation stages.
Show the source-linked stages and unknown inputs/effective dates.
Do not enter claimant data, derive rates or produce an award.
shots.permitted_claim: A business analyst can inspect proposed dependencies and blockers before execution is permitted.
shots.does_not_establish: There is no implemented, reviewed entitlement calculator in this demonstration.
shots.fallback: Use the real Requirements or Rates view and label the blocked Calculation view unavailable.

shots.title: Carer interactions are directional
shots.presentation_act: C — Inspecting and challenging the system
steps: Open staff-039 and Interactions.
Show the separate carer-income, carer-addition and cared-for-person entries.
Keep row ranges, omitted rows, uncertainty and source references visible.
shots.permitted_claim: The same named benefit can participate in different relationships depending on person and direction.
shots.does_not_establish: No symmetric interaction rule or actual award change has been established.
shots.fallback: Use the native table rather than a decorative graph; do not invent a fourth row in a bounded three-row response.

shots.title: The assistant changes an inspectable page view
shots.presentation_act: C — Inspecting and challenging the system
steps: Use an already authorised compatible sidebar session; first show staff-016 Requirements.
Capture the whole browser window including the real assistant panel and page.
Run the bounded follow-up to show staff-039 Interactions and capture the after state.
Record actual tool route, schemas, snapshot IDs, revisions, result IDs and visible state changes.
shots.permitted_claim: In this recorded session an assistant used the actual page tools to inspect evidence and change its presentation.
shots.does_not_establish: Developer-assisted native page-tool access is not automatic dedicated WebMCP discovery, remote MCP, universal client support, or validated reasoning.
shots.fallback: Mark sidebar capture BLOCKED with its exact reason; provide manually navigated S10/S11 as UI-only fallbacks, never as proof of agent action.

shots.title: Export a local review proposal
shots.presentation_act: C — Inspecting and challenging the system
steps: Use the actual review controls and clearly identify the entry as a screenshot rehearsal, not specialist approval.
Download a local proposal under the capture output directory.
Check that published packages and repository source are unchanged.
shots.permitted_claim: An inspectable suggestion can be handed to a separate review process.
shots.does_not_establish: Export does not approve a rule or change published evidence.
shots.fallback: Show the real review controls without exporting and explain the limitation.

shots.title: Audit how a passage was assembled
steps: Open a documented case from the 28-case queue.
Show source/extraction and before/proposed-after boundaries or How this passage was built.
Record which parser proposal and case were shown; preserve unresolved status where present.
shots.permitted_claim: The transformation from source to evidence can itself be inspected.
shots.does_not_establish: These are selected known outliers, not a random sample or corpus-wide error-rate estimate.
shots.fallback: Show the pinned source review document if the live viewer is unavailable; do not imply a new repair was made.

shots.title: Show what the checks actually measured
steps: Capture the original release record and relevant bound report rather than inventing a dashboard.
Show the technical checks with their denominators and the adjacent answerability limitations.
must_be_visible: 16 public browser checks, if reproduced from the original report
zero new answer-model calls for the stated increment
shots.permitted_claim: Recorded technical checks measure delivery, navigation and non-regression within their stated scope.
shots.does_not_establish: They do not measure improved answer accuracy; no percentage success chart should mix these denominators.
shots.fallback: Use the original report view with readable crops and source URL/date captions.

shots.title: Where colleagues can try the public learning route
steps: Open the actual public learning page and verify its destination.
Capture the relevant start/help section.
Optionally generate and decode-test a separate QR code to that confirmed public page.
shots.permitted_claim: The audience has a public entry point for learning about and inspecting the exemplar.
shots.does_not_establish: No universal browser/Voice support or official DWP service is implied.
shots.fallback: Use a verified pinned public repository guide and record the substituted QR target; never encode localhost or an expired tool result.
